about: The public format specifications a Holdout V2 template may cite (docs/BENCHMARK-V2.md, 'Holdout V2'). A template names one by id. The list says where a format is defined, not how a case looks: the template author reads the source itself. Added 2026-10-20, before any template.

specs.source: ISO 13616-1:2020 and the SWIFT IBAN Registry (country lengths and BBAN structure)
ISO/IEC 7812-1 (issuer identification number, Luhn check digit)
ITU-T E.164 (international numbering plan)
North American Numbering Plan Administrator, number format (NPA-NXX-XXXX)
Bundesnetzagentur, Nummernplan (German numbers)
RFC 5322 section 3.4.1 (addr-spec) and RFC 6531 (internationalized addresses)
RFC 791 and RFC 6890 (special-purpose ranges, to tell a public address from a reserved one)
RFC 4291 and RFC 5952 (text representation)
U.S. Social Security Administration, SSN randomization and the numbers never issued
German tax identification number, § 139b AO, and the BZSt check digit procedure
EU VAT number formats, VIES (European Commission)
ICAO Doc 9303 (machine readable travel documents, document numbers and check digits)
AAMVA DL/ID Card Design Standard (driver license number formats per jurisdiction)
ABA routing number format and check digit (American Bankers Association)
ISO 8601-1 (calendar dates) and common national date notations (CLDR)
UPU S42 international postal address components, and national postal address guides (USPS Publication 28, Deutsche Post)
Unicode CLDR person name formatting (TR35 part 8) and public name frequency lists of national statistics offices
RFC 3986 section 3.2.1 (user information in a URI)
The public documentation of each vendor's token format (the template names the page in its text field comment)
RFC 7468 (textual encodings of PKIX, PKCS and CMS structures)
NIST SP 800-63B section 5.1.1 (memorized secrets)
The public connection string documentation of each database (PostgreSQL libpq URI, MongoDB, Redis)
A negative case: text in the shape of a format without a sensitive value (documentation, ids of things, timestamps). The template cites the format it imitates in its id
